summary: PBDB has dated, taxon-resolved fossil occurrences with a marine/terrestrial environment filter (about 1.09 M marine and 246 k terrestrial Metazoa occurrences), which covers the needed variables; rates and sampling correction must be derived, and terrestrial sampling is visibly thinner.
next_step: Pre-register the clade matching, time bins and sampling standardisation, then download a stratified PBDB occurrence extract (the full set is far larger than 1 MB) and compute durations/origination/extinction per environment.
obstacles_confirmed: Terrestrial occurrences are about a quarter of marine Metazoa occurrences in PBDB (246,436 vs 1,090,143), so preservation bias is real.
PBDB is a compilation of nomenclature that differs between land and sea taxa; taxonomic splitting not assessed here.
